title: and I immediately locked IN @Deanna Giulietti #DEANNAS10OUTTA10BACHEL...
transcript: Running with my dress undone, screaming, but, daddy, I love him! I'm having his baby! No, I'm not. But you should see your faces. You just took off and I locked in.
